root_cause: Exclusive-writer SECURITY INVOKER lease functions did not pin search_path. Although every table reference is schema-qualified, a mutable execution search path is a security linter warning and leaves avoidable name-resolution variance.

prevention.pattern: Pin search_path to pg_catalog, writer_control on SECURITY INVOKER functions and retain original qualified body, ACL, owner and lease verification.
prevention.failure_policy: Abort migration if any required function is absent or suddenly SECURITY DEFINER; prove all three settings through pg_proc before allowing release.
prevention.rollout: Protected Required/BRAIN/CodeQL plus provider database migration history and post-deploy Security Advisor independent readback; no direct DDL bypass.
prevention.incident: Do not claim resolution until function metadata is read from the live provider and original alert disappears.

evidence.provider_observation: Supabase Security Advisor warning category for invoker functions, 2026-11-02
evidence.authorized_release: Existing exclusive writer and native branch protection; no alternate migration path.
